_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With only 5% of 12h windows producing ±2+ point moves over 7 days, this is a confirmed coil — the honest call is HOLD at Denial until the breaker reveals itself via ETF flow direction or DXY behavior.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction citing coil conditions and fragile liquidity-driven structure, while narrative implies directional accumulation UP; the split reflects structural disagreement on whether sentiment divergence is bullish or deceptive.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC funding stays below 0.02% AND ETF flows remain positive while price holds $62K+ — coil extends, Denial persists before potential Hope transition
next_move.invalidated_if: funding spikes above 0.05% with price rejection at $66K+ OR VIX breaks 20 with DXY above 101 — forces Anxiety or Panic reversion, killing the long
